_comment: Rebuilt 2026-09-16. The previous contents planned v7.9 for 30 Sept while the plugin
was already at 7.18.0 and v7.11.0 was a tag - the SECOND time this file scheduled a
version that had shipped; v7.19 was the third. `gate --audit` now reports a milestone
at or below the highest of plugin.json, the newest tag and CHANGELOG (REQ-PLANSTALE-1013).
Milestones are written in full, vX.Y.Z, the same form as tags and CHANGELOG headings.
`until` is pinned on purpose. The engine computes the horizon (year end, or three months
out) only for a plan with no dates; once bars or dues exist, the calendar ends at the
last of them. Without `until` this chart would stop at v8.0.0's due date.

bars.title: MCP server: expose reqmap as a tool
Consilium-py stays green on `check@v8`. Done when: at least 5 green runs on `main` since the re-vendoring (2026-09-21, Consilium-py #63)
An outside evaluator, on their own repo, with no help at the gate. Done when: they have `uses: alxmax/requirement-manager/check@v8` on a tree you do not commit to
Retire: comments only, writes checked
bars.roadmap: `retire --apply` strips a tag only from the comment it was written in, checks every write and stops a batch at its first failure. Done when: a string literal holding the tag's text survives, `applied: true` is not reported after a failed block removal (`retireapply.py:41-45` sets it and returns 0 either way), and a consumer whose retirement failed leaves its base requirement alone

bars.title: Words match the engine
bars.roadmap: The words about `sync` match what it does. Done when: `docs/commands.md:62` and `mcp.py:127` say an edited confirmed contract is demoted to draft (they say `sync` refuses), and `app/scripts/sync-data.mjs:4` points to `sync`, not to `reqmap.py export`, which no longer exists

bars.title: CI: budget on the PR, release waits for the smoke test
bars.roadmap: CI checks the engine budget on the pull request, and a release waits for the published-action smoke test. Done when: a pull request that adds one logical line over `CORE_LOGICAL_BUDGET` fails before merge (the script runs only in the `release` job, `ci.yml:375`, and the PR jobs run its test, `ci.yml:85,151`), and `release` does not go ahead while `dogfood.yml` is red

bars.title: The plan keeps only what is open
bars.roadmap: The plan keeps only what is open. Done when: the bar for the shipped MCP server and the one for the archived consumer repo, with that repo's ROADMAP item and the done licence line, are gone, and the outside-evaluator bar stays

bars.title: Answer the count questions, family by family
bars.roadmap: The `clause-without-case` and `over-scoped` questions are answered family by family. Done when: ARCH-VIEWER-007's nine are, and the next four families by count are too: fold obligations split over bullets, add the cases that are really missing with their tests, and split what is over-scoped with `clarify --decompose`

bars.title: Confirm the four drafts
bars.roadmap: Read and confirm REQ-EXTRACT-1099, REQ-VIEWER-1101, REQ-DRIFT-1103 and REQ-DRIFT-1104, the four drafts v8.24.0 to v8.24.4 shipped
